items.title: Restore missing save-thumbnail BMP sidecars

items.title: Confirm Ctrl+F9 / Ctrl+F10 work in game and do not trigger quick load

items.evidence: docs/fixes/quality-audit-2026-10-28.md#in-game-follow-up-1425 — owner confirms Ctrl+F9/F10 work as expected; runtime log records both cycles and enforcement. Plain F9 was not separately reported.

items.title: Many saves: save-list cost and resident previews (no save limit)
items.verify: Start test with fix_list_leak=1 and savelist_trace=1: open the Load menu twice from the main menu and twice in game; builds 2+ log 'leaked streams freed 60' and commit grows ~0 MB per open (was ~50 MB with 60 saves).
items.evidence: docs/fixes/save-bloat.md#confirmed-in-game-run-2-2026-10-30-1247 - leak fix confirmed: repeat Load-menu opens 0-1 MB instead of ~50 MB with 60 saves. Open: ~1 s per build not in Steam reads; ~1.7 MB per new preview held for the session.

items.title: Book marker in every item list: read, carried or nothing new, with status and tooltip
items.verify: Version 3 installed on the owner's machine: the game reaches the main menu; in the inventory (I) a read book shows the tick and '/ READ', an unread book with new content shows '/ UNREAD' and its tooltip lists what is new, one with nothing new shows '/ NOTHING NEW'; a merchant and the storage chest behave as in version 2; a looted container shows the tick and the status after a book's name.
items.evidence: docs/fixes/shop-book-read-marker.md - version 1 (read or carried) confirmed in game 2026-10-30; version 2's shop/storage behaviour was confirmed there too. Version 3 (2026-10-31) moved the marker into CGuiUtils.FillItemObject (with a 'merchant' context argument) and wrapped the loot window's name and icon pushes in container_class.ws. Dry run on the vanilla and the Mersey/HD UI archives: DZIP hash valid, only guiutils.ws/guishop.ws/container_class.ws differ, every declared name checked against the compiler's keywords (caught 'state'), uninstall restores all files byte-identically. In-game result pending. The loot window has no tooltip (ui_loot.swf imports only xfontlib.swf), so there the status goes after the item name. check_texts.py still passes for all 12 languages.
